Name: Wisteria Tree Mod v3
Author: forzaxv
Description:
[size=4][b][size=5]Wisteria Tree Mod - Content Patcher[/size][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Brings the Wisteria tree to the valley! This mod adds a fully custom, standalone tree[/color][color=#d4d4d8] with harvestable flowers [/color][color=#d4d4d8]to Stardew Valley.[/color]



[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[*][b]NPC Gifting Reactions [New]: [/b]Added unique NPC dialogue when presented with the Wisteria Flower and Wisteria Tea.[/*]
[*][b]Brand New Tree:[/b] Adds a Wisteria tree featuring vibrant purple flowers to the game.[/*]
[*][b]User-Friendly Shop Integration:[/b] You can purchase the Wisteria Sapling directly from [b]Pierre’s General Store[/b] for [b]2,000g[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Harvestable Flowers[/b]: Fully grown trees produce [b]1 Wisteria Flower per day[/b] during [b]Spring & Summer[/b]. Shake the tree to harvest it![/*]
[*][b]Wisteria Tea[/b]: Place a Wisteria Flower in a [b]Keg[/b] (takes 3 in game hours) to brew Wisteria Tea. Drinking it restores health/energy and grants a [b]+40 Max Stamina buff[/b] along with [b]+2 Luck [/b]for 7 minutes.[/*]
[*][b]Fast Growth Toggle (Optional)[/b]: Don't want to wait an entire season for your tree to grow? Toggle the [b]Fast Growth[/b] option in the mod settings to make the tree advance one growth stage every day (Generic Mod Config Menu required).

[size=4][b]All Gifting Reactions:[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]To use this mod, you will need to have the following standard frameworks installed:[/color]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][color=#d4d4d8] (4.0.0+)[/color][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][color=#d4d4d8] (2.0.0+)[/color][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url][color=#d4d4d8] [/color][i][color=#d4d4d8](Optional, for changing growth settings in game)[/color][/i][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8][b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Download and install the latest versions of [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Download this mod and unzip the contents.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Drop both unzipped [CP] Wisteria Tree and WisteriaTreeMod folders directly into your Stardew Valley Mods directory.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Launch the game using SMAPI, and head over to Pierre's :)[/color]
